import json,re,collections
with open('packet.json') as f:
    p=json.load(f)
for line in p['task'].splitlines():
    if line.startswith(('(:Tdoc).type','(:Tdoc).status','(:Section).specNumber','(:Section).sectionId','(:Spec).specNumber','(:Resolution).resolutionScope')):
        print(line)
groups=collections.defaultdict(list)
for x in p['items']:
    q=x['question']
    q=re.sub(r'R2-\\d+|RP-\\d+','<document>',q)
    q=re.sub(r'CR \\d+','CR <number>',q)
    q=re.sub(r'TS \\d+\\.\\d+','TS <spec>',q)
    q=re.sub(r'Rel-\\d+','<release>',q)
    q=re.sub(r'clause \\S+ of','clause <clause> of',q)
    groups[(q,tuple(x['fields']))].append(x['id'])
for (q,fields),ids in groups.items():
    print('\\nSHAPE',len(ids),list(fields),q)
print('\\nFIRST 75 ITEM REFERENCES')
for i,x in enumerate(p['items'][:75]):
    print(i,x['id'],','.join(x['fields']),re.findall(r'R2-\\d+|RP-\\d+|CR \\d+|TS \\d+\\.\\d+|Rel-\\d+|clause \\S+',x['question']))
PY"

item.text: The questions fall into six query shapes. I’ll use `DecisionDisposition` with `evidenceStatus = 'source_verified'` and `Resolution` with `resolutionScope = 'document_disposition'` for the requested decisions, and follow `REVISED_TO` for later versions.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json,re,collections
with open('packet.json',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    packet=json.load(f)
items=packet['items']
assert len(items)==140
assert len({item['id'] for item in items})==140

def literal(value):
    return \"'\"+value.replace('\\\\','\\\\\\\\').replace(\"'\",\"\\\\'\")+\"'\"

decision=(
    \"MATCH (r:Resolution {resolutionScope: 'document_disposition'})-[:HAS_DISPOSITION]->\"
    \"(dd:DecisionDisposition {evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'})-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]->(d)\\n\"
    \"MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {workingGroup: 'RAN2'})\\n\"
)
pack=\"MATCH (d)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack)\\n\"
expressions={
    'document':'d.tdocNumber',
    'final_document':'d.tdocNumber',
    'disposition':'dd.dispositionCode',
    'wg_meeting':'m.meetingNumber',
    'cr_pack':'p.crPackId',
    'tsg_meeting':'p.tsgMeeting',
    'clause':'s.sectionNumber',
}
patterns={
    'release_clause':re.compile(r'Which (Rel-\\d+) change requests that modify clause (\\S+) of TS (\\d+\\.\\d+) have a source-verified RAN2 disposition for the whole document and were submitted in a TSG RAN CR pack\\? Give each document, its disposition, the RAN2 meeting, and the CR pack document number\\.'),
    'decision_pack':re.compile(r'Change request (R2-\\d+) \\(CR (\\d+) to TS (\\d+\\.\\d+)\\) was handled by RAN2\\. What source-verified disposition did RAN2 record for the whole document and at which RAN2 meeting, and in which TSG RAN CR pack was it then submitted\\? Give the disposition, the RAN2 meeting, the CR pack document number and the TSG RAN meeting\\.'),
    'pack_documents':re.compile(r'TSG RAN CR pack (RP-\\d+) carries change requests from RAN2\\. For each change request in the pack that has a source-verified RAN2 disposition for the whole document, give the document, the disposition, and the RAN2 meeting\\.'),
    'decision_clauses':re.compile(r'Trace change request (R2-\\d+) \\(CR (\\d+) to TS (\\d+\\.\\d+)\\) from the RAN2 decision to the clauses it modifies\\. Give the source-verified disposition RAN2 recorded for the whole document, the RAN2 meeting, the TSG RAN CR pack document number, the TSG RAN meeting, and each clause of TS (\\d+\\.\\d+) that the CR modifies\\.'),
    'later_revisions':re.compile(r'RAN2 recorded document (R2-\\d+) as revised\\. Follow its revisions to every later version that has a source-verified RAN2 disposition for the whole document and was submitted in a TSG RAN CR pack\\. Give each such document, that disposition, and the CR pack document number\\.'),
    'pack_lookup':re.compile(r'In which TSG RAN CR pack was change request (R2-\\d+) \\(CR (\\d+) to TS (\\d+\\.\\d+)\\) submitted\\? Give the CR pack document number and the TSG RAN meeting\\.'),
}
expected_fields={
    'release_clause':['document','disposition','wg_meeting','cr_pack'],
    'decision_pack':['disposition','wg_meeting','cr_pack','tsg_meeting'],
    'pack_documents':['document','disposition','wg_meeting'],
    'decision_clauses':['disposition','wg_meeting','cr_pack','tsg_meeting','clause'],
    'later_revisions':['final_document','disposition','cr_pack'],
    'pack_lookup':['cr_pack','tsg_meeting'],
}
rows=[]
counts=collections.Counter()
representatives={}
for item in items:
    matches=[(name,pattern.fullmatch(item['question'])) for name,pattern in patterns.items()]
    matches=[(name,match) for name,match in matches if match]
    assert len(matches)==1,item['id']
    name,match=matches[0]
    assert item['fields']==expected_fields[name],item['id']
    args=match.groups()
    if name=='release_clause':
        release,clause,spec=args
        query=(
            \"MATCH (d:Tdoc)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(rel:Release {releaseName: \"+literal(release)+\"})\\n\"
            \"MATCH (d)-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]->(s:Section {specNumber: \"+literal(spec)+\", sectionNumber: \"+literal(clause)+\"})\\n\"
            +pack+decision
        )
    elif name=='decision_pack':
        query=\"MATCH (d:Tdoc {tdocNumber: \"+literal(args[0])+\"})\\n\"+pack+decision
    elif name=='pack_documents':
        query=\"MATCH (d:Tdoc)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack {crPackId: \"+literal(args[0])+\"})\\n\"+decision
    elif name=='decision_clauses':
        document,cr_number,spec,repeated_spec=args
        assert spec==repeated_spec,item['id']
        query=(
            \"MATCH (d:Tdoc {tdocNumber: \"+literal(document)+\"})\\n\"
            +pack+decision+
            \"MATCH (d)-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]->(s:Section {specNumber: \"+literal(spec)+\"})\\n\"
        )
    elif name=='later_revisions':
        query=(
            \"MATCH (origin:Tdoc {tdocNumber: \"+literal(args[0])+\"})-[:REVISED_TO*1..]->(d:Tdoc)\\n\"
            +pack+decision
        )
    elif name=='pack_lookup':
        query=\"MATCH (d:Tdoc {tdocNumber: \"+literal(args[0])+\"})\\n\"+pack
    else:
        raise AssertionError(name)
    query+='RETURN DISTINCT '+', '.join(expressions[field]+' AS '+field for field in item['fields'])
    aliases=re.findall(r'\\bAS\\s+(\\w+)',query.split('RETURN DISTINCT ',1)[1])
    assert aliases==item['fields'],item['id']
    assert query.count('RETURN DISTINCT ')==1
    without_literals=re.sub(r\"'(?:\\\\.|["'^'"'\\\\])*'\",\"'?'\",query)
    assert not re.search(r'\\b(CREATE|MERGE|SET|DELETE|REMOVE|CALL|LOAD|UNION|UNWIND|OPTIONAL|ORDER|LIMIT|SKIP)\\b',without_literals,re.I)
    rows.append({'id':item['id'],'cypher':query})
    counts[name]+=1
    representatives.setdefault(name,query)
shapes={re.sub(r\"'(?:\\\\.|["'^'"'\\\\])*'\",\"'?'\",row['cypher']) for row in rows}
assert len(shapes)==6
assert [row['id'] for row in rows]==[item['id'] for item in items]
serialized=[json.dumps(row,ensure_ascii=False) for row in rows]
assert all(json.loads(line)==row for line,row in zip(serialized,rows))
with open('queries.jsonl','w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write('\\n'.join(serialized)+'\\n')
print(json.dumps({'queries_written':len(rows),'distinct_query_shapes':len(shapes),'shape_counts':dict(counts),'wording_uncertainties':[]},ensure_ascii=False))
for name,query in representatives.items():
    print('\\n'+name+'\\n'+query)
PY"
